baseline_reconciliation.discrepancy_explanation: Marginal rank variations between 'stop' and other maneuvers on boundary samples caused by unseeded IntentClassifier initialization in ad-hoc runs. Fully resolved and frozen via canonical_intent_classifier.pth.

decision_rationale: S1L3 achieved higher macro Change gain (+1.49 pp vs +1.25 pp), higher macro Overall gain (+0.66 pp vs +0.37 pp), superior cross-seed consistency (8/9 positive runs vs 7/9, 0 negative runs on Change), and strict compliance with all motion and error guards.
